doc: Securely fetches Tiptap Server AI Toolkit v4 tool definitions. Configure Tiptap AI credentials in the plugin settings. All tools are disabled unless named in the explicit allowlist.

editor_context_json.caption: AI editor context (JSON)
editor_context_json.doc: Use the Tiptap element's AI editor context state. AI Toolkit compatibility must be enabled so hashes survive later edits.
editor_context_json.name: editor_context_json

tool_allowlist.caption: Tool allowlist (comma-separated)
tool_allowlist.doc: Exact v4 tool names to enable. Supported: tiptapRead, tiptapEdit, getThreads, editThreads, readDocument, readSelection, proofread. Leave empty to enable no tools. Start with tiptapRead,tiptapEdit for the common read/edit workflow.
tool_allowlist.name: tool_allowlist
